name: Weapon
description:
Weapons are entities with firing, reloading and aiming functionalities.

They are fully customizable, all pieces of the weapon can be changed with immense possibility of creation.

parameters.name: spawn_mode
parameters.description: Pass SpawnMode.AfterConstructor or SpawnMode.Manual to avoid immediately sending the entity to clients and improve performance when you want to configure it by setting several configs. Must call FinishSpawn() after all

functions.name: Reload
functions.description: Forces this Weapon to reload
functions.description_long: Forces this Weapon to reload (only if being handled by a Character)

functions.name: SetAmmoBag
functions.description: Sets this Weapon's Ammo in the Bag

parameters.name: new_ammo_bag
parameters.description: The new Ammo in the Bag

functions.name: SetAmmoClip
functions.description: Sets this Weapon's Ammo in the Clip

parameters.name: new_ammo_clip
parameters.description: The new Ammo in the Clip

functions.name: SetAmmoSettings
functions.description: Sets the ammo counts and the clip capacity at once

parameters.name: ammo_clip
parameters.description: Bullets currently loaded in the clip

parameters.name: ammo_bag
parameters.description: Spare bullets carried, used when reloading

parameters.name: ammo_to_reload
parameters.description: Bullets loaded on each reload, useful for shotguns that load one shell at a time. Defaults to the clip capacity

parameters.name: clip_capacity
parameters.description: Max bullets the clip can hold

functions.name: SetAnimationFire
functions.description: Sets the Animation played by the Weapon itself when firing

parameters.name: animation_fire_path
parameters.description: The Animation asset to play on the Weapon mesh

functions.name: SetAnimationCharacterFire
functions.description: Sets the Animation played by the Character when firing this Weapon

parameters.name: animation_character_fire_path
parameters.description: The Animation asset to play on the Character

functions.name: SetAnimationReload
functions.description: Sets the Animation played by the Character when reloading this Weapon

parameters.name: reload_animation_path
parameters.description: The Animation asset to play on the Character

functions.name: GetAnimationReload
functions.description: Gets the reload animation

functions.name: SetAutoReload
functions.description: Sets if the Character will reload automatically when the clip is empty
functions.description_long: If the Character will reload automatically when ammo empties. Default is true

functions.name: SetBulletColor
functions.description: Set the Bullet Color
functions.description_long:
Set the Bullet Color

Only has effect if using Bullet Trail particle P_Bullet_Trail or if you particle has the Color parameter

functions.name: SetBulletSettings
functions.description: Sets how many bullets are fired per shot and how they look and travel

parameters.name: bullet_max_distance
parameters.description: Max distance the bullet travels (in units, 1 unit = 1 cm)

functions.name: SetCadence
functions.description: Sets the time between shots

functions.name: SetClipCapacity
functions.description: Sets the max number of bullets the Weapon's clip can hold

functions.name: SetDamage
functions.description: Set the Base Weapon's Damage
functions.description_long:
Base Weapon's Damage

This will be multiplied by multiplier factors when hitting specific bones

functions.name: SetHandlingMode
functions.description: Sets how the Character grabs this Weapon

parameters.name: handling_mode
parameters.description: The new how the Character grabs this Weapon

functions.name: SetLeftHandTransform
functions.description: Sets where the Character's left hand holds this Weapon, relative to the Weapon

parameters.name: left_hand_location
parameters.description: Location offset of the left hand

parameters.name: left_hand_rotation
parameters.description: Rotation offset of the left hand

functions.name: SetMagazineMesh
functions.description: Set the mesh used when the Character reloads the weapon
functions.description_long:
Set the mesh used when the Character reloads the weapon.

Will drop this Mesh as an animation effect.

parameters.name: magazine_mesh
parameters.description: The Static Mesh of the magazine, spawned in the Character's hand during the reload

parameters.name: magazine_mesh_hide_bone
parameters.description: Weapon bone to hide when reloading it

functions.name: PlayAnimation
functions.description: Plays an Animation on this Weapon

parameters.name: slot_name
parameters.description: The Animation Slot to play it on

parameters.name: loop_indefinitely
parameters.description: This parameter is only used if the Weapon has an Animation Blueprint

parameters.name: blend_in_time
parameters.description: This parameter is only used if the Weapon has an Animation Blueprint

parameters.name: blend_out_time
parameters.description: This parameter is only used if the Weapon has an Animation Blueprint

parameters.name: play_rate
parameters.description: This parameter is only used if the Weapon has an Animation Blueprint

parameters.name: stop_all_montages
parameters.description: Stops all running Montages from the same Group. This parameter is only used if the Weapon has an Animation Blueprint

functions.name: StopAnimation
functions.description: Stops an Animation Montage on this Weapon

parameters.name: animation_asset
parameters.description: Leave empty to stop all Montages

functions.name: SetParticlesBulletTrail
functions.description: Sets the Particle of the bullet trail

parameters.name: particle_bullet_trail_asset_path
parameters.description: The Particle asset to spawn for each bullet

functions.name: SetParticlesBarrel
functions.description: Sets the Particle of the fire blast at the muzzle

parameters.name: particle_asset_path
parameters.description: The Particle asset to spawn at the muzzle when firing

functions.name: SetParticlesShells
functions.description: Sets the Particle of the empty shells ejected when firing

parameters.name: particle_shells_asset_path
parameters.description: The Particle asset to spawn when ejecting a shell

functions.name: SetRightHandOffset
functions.description: Set the offset of Right Hand
functions.description_long: Set the Offset of Right Hand. To position relative to the camera.

parameters.name: right_hand_offset
parameters.description: The new offset of Right Hand

functions.name: SetSightFOVMultiplier
functions.description: Sets the Field of View multiplier applied when aiming down sights

parameters.name: sight_fov_multiplier
parameters.description: Values below 1 zoom in, for example 0.5 for a scope

functions.name: SetSightTransform
functions.description: Sets the offset that aligns the Player's view with the Weapon's sight when aiming down sights

parameters.name: sight_location
parameters.description: Offset between the camera and the sight

parameters.name: sight_rotation
parameters.description: Rotation applied to the Weapon while aiming

functions.name: SetSoundZooming
functions.description: Sets the Sound played when zooming

functions.name: SetSoundFire

functions.name: SetSpread
functions.description: Sets the base spread of this Weapon

parameters.name: spread
parameters.description: the higher the less precision - recommended value: 20

functions.name: SetUsageSettings

parameters.name: hold_release_use
parameters.description: Whether it only fires when the fire button is released (e.g. bows)

events.name: Fire
events.description: Triggered when Weapon fires (this will be triggered for each shot)

arguments.name: self
arguments.description: The Weapon that triggered the event

arguments.name: shooter
arguments.description: The Character holding the Weapon, if any

events.name: BulletHit
events.description: Triggered when bullets hit (this will be triggered for each bullet shot)

arguments.name: self
arguments.description: The Weapon that triggered the event

arguments.name: impact_point
arguments.description: Location in world space of the bullet hit

arguments.name: impact_normal
arguments.description: Normal of the bullet hit in world space

arguments.name: actor_hit
arguments.description: Actor entity that was hit, if any
